prerequisites.notes: Compilation passes. No checkstyle plugin configured. Spec verified at ../tenxengage-blueprint/features/wallet-ledger-foundation/spec.md. 2 pre-existing unit test failures (LocationServiceTest, LocalStorageProviderTest) exist on main — not introduced by this branch.

findings.message: java-code-review suggested clearAutomatically=true on acquireGrantLock @Modifying. Adversarial review found this INCORRECT for advisory lock SELECT — would evict Incentive from persistence context causing LazyInitializationException on Incentive.budgets (LAZY @OneToMany) in non-JOIN-FETCH callers (ActivityCompletionService, JourneyCompletionService). Fix attempted and reverted. flushAutomatically=true is correct and sufficient.
findings.manualAction: Do NOT add clearAutomatically to advisory lock queries. pg_advisory_xact_lock modifies no rows — cache clearing is harmful when lazy associations are in the same persistence context.

findings.message: findByClientId returns all RewardTransactions for a client with no pagination — OOM risk on high-volume clients.
findings.manualAction: Add Pageable overload: Page<RewardTransaction> findByClientId(UUID clientId, Pageable pageable).

findings.message: findByClientIdAndUserId loads all transactions for a user with no limit.
findings.manualAction: Add Pageable parameter or limit to a recent time window.

findings.message: findByClientIdAndIncentiveId loads all transactions for a client+incentive pair with no pagination.
findings.manualAction: Add Pageable support or replace with aggregate query where callers only need totals.

findings.message: hashtext() produces a 32-bit hash — collision probability non-trivial at scale for distinct (incentiveId:userId) pairs.
findings.manualAction: Use pg_advisory_xact_lock(bigint, bigint) with two separate hashtext() calls for a 64-bit combined key.

findings.message: Null-guard throws IllegalArgumentException after @Transactional proxy opens a transaction — wasteful for a programming-error condition.
findings.manualAction: Validate at RewardGrantRequest construction site using Objects.requireNonNull(), before the transactional boundary.

findings.message: @Audited action='CREATED' on creditInCurrentTx is inaccurate — called on every credit, not just wallet creation.
findings.manualAction: Change @Audited action to 'CREDITED', or move @Audited to credit() only.

code-review.notes: 3 HIGH performance findings (unbounded queries) are pre-existing in repository layer, not introduced by this branch's 3-file change. clearAutomatically fix attempted and reverted after adversarial review identified LazyInitializationException risk on Incentive.budgets lazy proxy.

findings.summary: Per-user and per-partner cap SUM queries without row-level lock — RESOLVED via pg_advisory_xact_lock on (incentiveId:userId)
creditInCurrentTx() wallet creation race — RESOLVED via ensureIndividualWalletExists() + findForUpdate()
clearAutomatically=true on advisory lock SELECT would detach Incentive causing LazyInitializationException — fix attempted and reverted
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — clearAutomatically fix reverted; flushAutomatically=true only is correct
findings.recommendation: Do not add clearAutomatically to advisory lock queries.

findings.summary: grantReward() calls creditInCurrentTx(awarded=ZERO) when fully capped — creates zero-amount ledger entries
findings.recommendation: Add early return when awarded <= 0 before creating the RewardTransaction and calling creditInCurrentTx.

findings.summary: Per-partner cap race across different users for same partner+incentive — advisory lock only serializes per (incentiveId:userId)
findings.recommendation: Add a second pg_advisory_xact_lock on (incentiveId:partnerCompanyId) when partnerCompanyId is non-null.
